notes.title: What's new in v2.2(53)
notes.notes:
- Introducing Boom 3D Headphone EQ: 
We have added support for the automatic headphone equalization of over 5000 models of headphones. This will automatically compensate for imperfections in the headphones’ sound reproduction.

- Always show all EQ bands in Advanced Mode: 
Certain frequency bands of the equalizer would be hidden unless hovered upon with the cursor. We have now changed this to ensure that all the frequency bands are always visible.

- Fixed a crash found during launch 

We hope you enjoy these new features! Please feel free to reach out to us at boom3@globaldelight.com with feedback and suggestions for future updates! :)

notes.title: What's new in v1.4.7
notes.notes:
- Remembering Your Last Output Device:
Boom 3D would sometimes ‘forget’ your last selected output device when your Mac wakes from sleep, or is rebooted. This has been fixed.

- Bluetooth/USB Device Auto-switching:
By default, Boom 3D automatically switches to Bluetooth or USB devices when connected. If this is not preferred, we have provided toggle switches in the Settings tab to turn it off.

- UI and Localisation Fixes:
We’ve made some minor improvements to the interface and fixed some localisation errors.

We really hope you’re enjoying Boom 3D, and would really appreciate your feedback and suggestions! Write to us on boom3@globaldelight.com. Your sound, your say! :)

notes.title: What's New in v1.4.1
notes.notes:
- We have fixed a bug that was causing excessive memory usage.

New Feature - 5.1 Multichannel Audio Support
- The latest update of Boom 3D, creates a very immersive virtual surround feel by spatialising all audio channels of a 5.1 surround audio from games, music, and movies enriching the fidelity and depth of sound for lifelike sound on any standard headphones. Spatialising different channels of surround audio track on headphones results in distinct perception of different audio channels on headphones with clarity. 
- On 5.1 home theatre systems, stereo audio can now be played on all its surround speakers (multichannel output). This option can be turned on in Settings > General Preferences.

notes.title: What's New in v1.4?
notes.notes:
New Feature - 5.1 Multichannel Audio Support

- The latest update of Boom 3D, creates a very immersive virtual surround feel by spatialising all audio channels of a 5.1 surround audio from games, music, and movies enriching the fidelity and depth of sound for lifelike sound on any standard headphones. Spatialising different channels of surround audio track on headphones results in distinct perception of different audio channels on headphones with clarity.
 
While earlier, 5.1 multichannel audio was being down-mixed to stereo and then virtualized into 3D surround sound. Now, with this update, Boom 3D is fully compatible with multichannel audio, so it enhances every single channel that is sent into it. 

This ensures that there is no loss in audio quality, and makes for a much more immersive listening experien

- On 5.1 home theatre systems, stereo audio can now be played on all its surround speakers (multichannel output). This option can be turned on in Settings > General Preferences.

We hope you enjoy this update! :)

Until next time,
Team Boom 3D
